ApplyPosture: feet keep footRot captured before pelvis lean/tilt; footFollow (kneel/lie) lets them follow the shins then floor-push via LowestFootPoint
BodyMatter::Step: held food hangs below the palm: to eat, aim the palm at (mouth + 5cm forward) - (food - palm); bite reach is 6cm from the food's surface
BodyState::Swallow: Digestion compartments in game hours: stomach (exp 1.2 h) -> gut (6 h) -> colon (14 h) -> rectum. Stool = 4x residue (75% water). Need::Bowel = rectumG/2.2. Hunger still drops at swallow (satiety), kcal not delayed.
Character::ApplyTissueContact: breast/glute squash: scales the soft bone along the bone axis closest to world up, volume kept (spread 1/sqrt)
ExpandPrefabs: Parts get ids instance*1000+n, so Zone::NextId skips _from/spawned entities (else ids explode). Buttons on a cabinet face need ~5 mm standoff from neighbours (Jolt margin) or they never travel.
Learner::Observe: hands are processed before vision so an action and its effect in the same tick get linked; causeWindow 1s
Motor::Ray: rays that skip what she holds (feet would step onto a carried crate)
Motor::StanceTargetsAt: used when a hop changes her frame (rolling over: yaw+pi; bed lie-down/sit-up: yaw+-pi/2 and pos moves); applied on arrival in UpdateStance
Motor::UpdateHands: palm = hand_ capsule (kPalm 8cm past wrist), fingertip = tip_ body used when HandShape::Point; drive stiffness = mass*(2pi f)^2, so light bodies need high freq/mass (tip 0.2kg @15Hz)
on release: withdraw_ pulls the hand back 0.35s before relaxing (else it drops onto levers)
Perception::Sense: SENSOR FIREWALL: entity ids/names/types must never leave this function; tracks are scrambled ids keyed by zone+entity
TestDigestion: 1600 g / 2000 kcal / 45 g residue day -> ~145 g in the rectum after 30 h (normal 100-200 g/day).
World::AirTemperature: heater warmth = W*0.012/(0.25+d^2) C, capped 25 per heater: a 120 W 12 V element is only ~3 C at 45 cm (realistic)
World::Bite: Food is a voxel block (~12 cells on its long side, FoodRt.vox 0 eaten/1 skin/2 flesh). A bite removes the ~12 g of voxels nearest the mouth (in the food's local frame) and marks neighbours as flesh. Unbitten food renders as its plain box; bitten food as x-runs, buried runs skipped.
World::BuildDoor: Door panels must clear the floor (bottom >= ~1 cm): floor friction under a 6 kg door looked like a 3x too-strong seal.
World::BuildEntity: buttons mounted flush on another static body get stuck (Jolt contact margin): give the button base a ~5 mm standoff from the surface it sits on
World::FlowStream: body streams (peeing) start inside her torso collider: they raycast with skipAgent=true; tap streams start 6mm below the spout so they don't hit the tap
World::RayCast: pass skipAgent=true from Jenny's code or rays hit her own hands/torso
World::SpawnStool: Raycasts down (skipAgent) first: if a container/bowl is below, stool goes into ContainerRt.stoolG (drawn as lumps, cleared by its drain/flush). Spawning a body there would start inside the static toilet box and get ejected.
